thread:
arjun: Following up on the postmortem for INC-2026 (recurring DB connection spike). Need owners for the action items so we can get them into Jira and set realistic timelines. Please claim or reassign by EOD Wed.

arjun: Action items I sketched (please confirm ownership):
- ENG-4821: add connection-pool metrics + threshold alert (owner?)
- ENG-4822: improve circuit-breaker behavior under sustained backpressure (owner?)
- ENG-4823: runbook update + oncall playbook (owner?)
- ENG-4824: capacity test & canary for connection pooling (owner?)

sophia: I'll take ENG-4821 (metrics + alert). ETA end of week. :+1:

liam: I can own ENG-4824 (capacity test/canary). Need help filing infra quota — @maria can you pair on the quota request?

maria: Yep, I can file the cloud quota ticket today and pair tomorrow AM. Also we should decide RACI for ENG-4822 — is that runtime or platform responsible?

arjun: Good question. Proposal: R=runtime team, A=eng-platform, C=oncall, I=pm. So runtime implements, platform approves rollout and infra changes.

liam: Works for me. Anders from runtime, can you confirm ENG-4822?

anders-runtime: Confirmed — I will own ENG-4822. Expect initial PRs by next Tue. Blocking item: prioritization vs sprint schedule. Can we get this into sprint-47?

maria: I'll push for it in sprint planning. If it doesn't make the sprint, we can schedule a hotfix canary window.

oncall-bot: Incident summary for INC-2026 posted: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026. Postmortem draft: https://docs.redwood.com/pm/INC-2026-pm

sophia: For ENG-4823 (runbook) I can draft the initial playbook once ENG-4821 (metrics) is live. Tagging docs: @tess-docs for review.

tess-docs: Happy to review — aim to return feedback within 48h.

arjun: Owners so far: ENG-4821 = sophia, ENG-4822 = anders-runtime, ENG-4823 = sophia + tess-docs, ENG-4824 = liam + maria. I'll update the postmortem and create the Jira tickets/subtasks. Please add due dates in the Jira issues: metrics+alert = 2026-04-03, runbook = 2026-04-06, code fix = 2026-04-07, capacity test = 2026-04-08.

liam: Noted. Also flagging that this looks like a recurring pattern — we've seen similar spikes in the last 3 months around batch job windows. Suggest adding a recurring-incident section to the PM with trend charts and a hypothesis list.

maria: +1. I'll gather historical graphs (p95/connection-errors) and append to the PM.

arjun: Great. Let's do a 30min sync on Fri 09:30 PST to confirm owners & blockers; I'll send a calendar invite. If anyone is blocked earlier, please ping here. :thumbsup:
